descripcion:
Netflix price increase: why did Netflix raise prices? In its Q4 2024 letter to shareholders (January 2025), Netflix wrote: "As we continue to invest in programming and deliver more value for our members, we will occasionally ask our members to pay a little more so that we can re-invest to further improve Netflix."

How much did Netflix make that year? Its 10-K for 2024, the annual report it files with the SEC, reports $8.7 billion in net income, the profit left after all costs and taxes.

"A little more", next to $8.7 billion. You decide.

Sources: Netflix Q4 2024 shareholder letter (8-K, Ex. 99.1); Netflix Form 10-K for 2024.
